name_zh: 塞内加尔·利奥波德·桑戈尔：黑人精神与诗人总统法语文化
name_en: Senegal Leopold Senghor: Negritude & Poet President French Culture
description_zh: 利奥波德·桑戈尔 (1906-2001) 塞内加尔首任总统 (1960-1980)，黑人精神运动创始人，诗人总统以法语文学连接非洲与欧洲，和平退位树立民主榜样，文化外交桥梁。
description_en: Leopold Sedar Senghor (1906-2001) Senegal first President (1960-1980), Negritude movement founder, poet President bridging Africa and Europe through French literature, peaceful retirement democratic model, cultural diplomacy bridge.
reason_zh: 桑戈尔代表非洲知识分子如何通过文学与政治双重身份构建文化自信，展示了黑人精神如何将殖民语言转化为文化抵抗武器，其和平退位与法兰西院士身份双重巅峰独树一帜。
reason_en: Senghor represents how African intellectual builds cultural confidence through dual literary-political identity, demonstrating how Negritude transforms colonial language into cultural resistance weapon, his peaceful retirement and Academie Francaise membership dual peaks unique.
steps_zh: 研究桑戈尔早年巴黎索邦大学与黑人精神宣言
分析1960年独立总统与黑人精神文化政策
探讨法语诗歌创作与法兰西院士终身席位
评估1980年和平退位与迪乌夫继任民主传承
总结黑人精神诗人总统法语文化对非洲文化外交的永恒范式
steps_en: Study Senghor early Paris Sorbonne and Negritude manifesto
Analyze 1960 independence President and Negritude cultural policy
Explore French poetry creation and Academie Francaise lifetime seat
Evaluate 1980 peaceful retirement and Diouf succession democratic transmission
Summarize Negritude poet President French culture eternal paradigm for African cultural diplomacy
expected_zh: 掌握文学如何成为民族文化自信建构的核心工具，理解殖民语言如何被转化为文化主权表达媒介，评估桑戈尔模式对法语非洲文化外交与民主传承的双重示范。
expected_en: Master how literature becomes national cultural confidence construction core tool, grasp how colonial language transforms into cultural sovereignty expression medium, evaluate Senghor model dual demonstration for Francophone African cultural diplomacy and democratic transmission.
case_zh: 1906 出生；1960 总统；1980 退位；2001 逝世。黑人精神诗人总统法语文化范式永存。
case_en: 1906 birth; 1960 President; 1980 retirement; 2001 death. Negritude poet President French culture paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Negritude / African Cultural Nationalism / French Literature
cross_cultural_impact: Negritude; poet President; French language; cultural diplomacy
